allocation_reducer: Median of each process’s thirty operation regions, then six paired process ratios. Retained delta and peak-above-entry are observer metrics, not physical RSS.
native_reducer: Nearest-rank process quantiles; GNU time maximum RSS per process; matched block bootstrap per frozen plan.
reason: Equal-length executable and output argument paths avoid the known argv-length/heap-layout confound; semantic leg identity stays in started receipts.
scope: All captures serialized, CPU12, no build overlaps; qualification and seek observers are separate, never pooled.
